description:
State document, in Arabic script. A late Fatimid report The verso is probably annotations or reply to the report mentioning the caliphal ʿalāma: al-ʿalāma al-sharīfa al-nabawiyya.

The main content of the petition seems to be about an ʿimāra (wa-yaḥtāṭ al-ʿimāra), the sender then seems to mention something about the cost/accounts (wa-yākhudh al-mawla bi-dafʿ al-ḥisābāt). The document ends with the raʾy clause: "al-ʾārā al-ʿāliyya zādahā allahu sharafan wa-yanfaʿu bihi".
description_he: מסמך לא מזוהה בכתב ערבי. השורה השנייה של הרקטו מכילה חַמְדַּלָה. דרוש בדיקה.
